verdict.rationale: The evidence shows checkpointers and time travel, which persist and rewind a thread's runtime graph state. That is rollback of execution state, an adjacent capability, not versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automation (graph) definitions themselves. Nothing in the pack documents version history, diff or review, or rollback of deployed graphs or assistants.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
